nav.shortStaysDesc: Nightly stays in serviced Cairo homes

home.heroSubtitle: Hand-picked apartments across Zamalek, Garden City, Maadi and New Cairo — hotel-grade care, the warmth of a real home, and a local host one message away.
home.projectsEmpty: Neighbourhoods will appear here once they are added.
home.featuredEmpty: Featured homes will appear here once units are published from the PMS.
home.hostBody: We turn Cairo apartments into five-star stays — styling, listing, pricing, guests and housekeeping, all handled while you follow everything from your owner portal.
home.heroSlide4: The city of a thousand minarets
home.introBody: Cairo is loud, generous and endlessly layered. Our homes are the quiet counterpoint — calm, beautifully kept apartments in the neighbourhoods we know best, prepared like a boutique hotel and lived in like your own place.
home.introBody2: Whether you're here for three nights or three months — for business, family or the Pyramids at sunrise — we take care of the details so the city can take care of the rest.
home.introImageAlt: A calm bedroom in a Cairo Homes apartment
home.neighbourhoodsBody: From leafy island streets to the quiet compounds of New Cairo — every neighbourhood has its own rhythm. Pick yours.
home.featuredBody: A few of our most-loved stays — each one inspected, styled and serviced by our own team.
home.trustBody: Every Cairo Homes stay runs on the same promise — the reliability of a hotel with the character and space of a real home.
home.trust0Body: We only list apartments we'd happily stay in ourselves — inspected in person, furnished with care and photographed honestly.
home.trust1Body: Professional cleaning between every stay, fresh linens and the essentials stocked before you arrive.
home.trust2Body: One team from first message to checkout — on WhatsApp day and night, and on the ground whenever you need us.
home.trust3Body: Transparent nightly rates, secure online payment and no surprises at checkout.
home.conciergeBody: Tell us how you like to travel and we'll arrange the rest — on request, before or during your stay.
home.concierge0Body: A driver waiting at Cairo International, straight to your door.
home.concierge1Body: Groceries and breakfast basics ready for your first morning.
home.concierge2Body: Trusted private guides for Giza, Saqqara and Khan el-Khalili.
home.concierge3Body: An hour on the Nile, just as the city turns gold.
home.concierge4Body: Weekly cleaning, a proper workspace and anything else a longer stay needs.

home.hostPoint2Body: Monthly statements and live bookings in your owner portal.

about.heroBody: We're a Cairo hospitality company that looks after beautiful homes and the people who stay in them — with the standards of a boutique hotel and the warmth of a local friend.
about.story1: So we set out to bridge the two. We partner with owners across Zamalek, Garden City, Maadi, Heliopolis, New Cairo and Sheikh Zayed, and prepare every home to one consistent standard — thoughtful furnishing, spotless housekeeping and clear, honest listings.
about.story2: Behind every stay is one coordinated team — reservations, housekeeping, operations and guest care — working from a single system, so that booking, arriving and living in Cairo feels effortless.
about.qualityBody: We maintain a high finish across every unit, from material choices and styling to cleanliness, consistency, and the standard of the guest experience.
about.teamworkBody: Our operations, guest support, and property care teams work as one system so owners and guests feel a smooth, coordinated service at every step.
about.respectBody: We respect every property as an asset, every guest as a priority, and every owner relationship as a long-term partnership built on trust.
about.integrityBody: Clear communication, transparent operations, and honest reporting guide how we manage bookings, care plans, and everyday hospitality decisions.
about.responsibilityBody: We take ownership of the details that protect value over time, keeping the property experience organised, dependable, and carefully maintained.
about.innovativeBody: We keep refining how we host — from our booking flow to our housekeeping checklists — so the experience feels modern without losing its warmth.
about.storyLead: Cairo Homes began with a simple observation: the city is full of wonderful apartments, and travellers deserve better than a gamble.

owners.bullet0: We visit your apartment, understand your goals and share an honest income estimate.
owners.bullet1: Styling, professional photography and a polished listing on our site and partner channels.
owners.bullet2: Guests, pricing, housekeeping and maintenance handled — with clear monthly statements.

faq.title: Questions,
faq.body: Everything you need to know before, during and after your stay.
faq.stillBody: Our guest team is on WhatsApp around the clock.

items.q: How do I book a stay?
items.a: Pick your dates and guests on any home, then reserve and pay securely online. Some homes are inquiry-only — for those, message us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm availability.

items.q: What time are check-in and check-out?
items.a: Check-in is from 3:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out can often be arranged — just ask.
Every stay begins with a professionally cleaned home and fresh linens. Longer stays include regular housekeeping, and extra cleans can be booked at any time.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: You can pay online by card through our secure payment partner. Monthly stays can also be settled by bank transfer.
Policies vary by home and are always shown before you pay. See our refund policy for the full details.

items.q: Can you arrange airport pickup or tours?
items.a: Yes. Airport transfers, private guides, groceries and more can be arranged on request through our team.
Yes — browse "Monthly stays" for fully furnished homes available by the month.

items.q: I own an apartment in Cairo. Can you manage it?
items.a: We'd love to hear from you. Visit our owners page and request a callback.
